title: Altman tells Fortune OpenAI will not IPO in 2026, citing 'ill-advised moment' over AI safety
summary: OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman said the company will not go public this year, telling Fortune that 'given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public, and we don't feel pressure on that'. Altman confirmed his support for Anthropic's 'pace the frontier' framework and said OpenAI would embed third-party evaluators with employee-like access. Bloomberg reports SoftBank's OpenAI bet fell sharply in Tokyo over the weekend, with the conglomerate's shares down roughly 13%.
